param.selectNeedsOption: select requires at least one option
param.sqlRequired: enter the SQL query for the options
param.sqlNoOptions: options of an SQL list are defined by the query
param.multipleDefaults: several values are allowed only with multiple choice
param.sqlOnlyQuery: SQL is allowed only for the “SQL list” type
param.multipleOnlyQuery: multiple choice is allowed only for the “SQL list” type

datasource.caOnlyVerify: a CA certificate is set only for the “SSL with verification” mode
datasource.pemExpected: a certificate in PEM format is expected

chart.stackedOnly: stacking — only for bars, lines and areas
chart.smoothOnly: smoothing — only for lines, areas and combined charts
chart.kindOnlyCombo: series type and axis — only for combined charts
chart.pieOneSeries: pie and doughnut charts — exactly one series
chart.pieNoSplit: series from data are not available for pie and doughnut charts
chart.splitOneSeries: with series from data — exactly one series (value column)
chart.splitColors: colors of series from data come from the palette
chart.axisY2Only: secondary axis — only for a combined chart with a series on the right axis
chart.chartsKeyTaken: the key charts is taken by charts

pdf.pdfaProtection: PDF/A is incompatible with a password and restrictions
pdf.signatureProtection: Signature is incompatible with a password and restrictions
pdf.tagFormatter: PDF fields allow tags without formatters only: {{tag}}
pdf.attachmentNotPdfa: PDF/A is enabled: file “{{name}}” is not in PDF/A format

transfer.fileExt: the template file must have the .{{ext}} extension
transfer.chartNoQuery: no query “{{query}}” in the archive template
transfer.chartQueryList: query “{{query}}” must return a list of rows
transfer.nameDuplicate: name “{{name}}” is repeated in the archive

import.targetUpdatedAtRequired: specify the modification time from the preview
import.targetOnlyUpdate: the template to update is specified only for “update”
import.targetUpdatedAtOnlyUpdate: the modification time is specified only for “update”
